title: Effect of metal salts on the morphology of Mn 2 O 3  hollow spheres and their application for CO 2  fixation reactions
content: Porous Mn2O3 hollow spheres were synthesized by a facile hydrothermal method, followed by a calcination process. The effect of the source of metal salts in this synthesis was investigated. The best result was obtained when MnCO3 was used as the starting material. It acts as a highly effective catalyst in the CO2 cycloaddition reaction under optimized conditions.
